description: This is a Go source file implementing a test scanner for cryptographic test vectors, specifically for converting test data into fuzzing inputs for BoringSSL's BN (big number) functions.

classes.name: test
classes.description: Struct representing a cryptographic test case with line number, type, and associated big number values.

classes.name: testScanner
classes.description: Struct for scanning and parsing test vectors from input reader, maintaining scanner state and errors.

methods.name: newTestScanner
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new testScanner from an io.Reader.

methods.name: scanLine
methods.description: Advances the scanner by one line, updating line number.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Parses a line into key-value attribute, updating test values.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Reads and parses a complete test vector from input.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Returns the current parsed test case.

methods.name: Err
methods.description: Returns any error encountered during scanning.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets an error with line number context.
